name: the-war-on-news
title: The War On News
description: How governments have limited journalists, 1900 to today. The public record of https://thewaronnews.com: incidents, events, actors, outlets, journalists, cases, sources, claims, tactics, countries, recent coverage, explainers, glossary terms, their join tables and the change ledger.

resources.name: incidents
resources.description: One row per recorded incident: a dated government action that limited reporting.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL identifier; the record lives at https://thewaronnews.com/<section>/<slug>.

fields.name: occurred_on
fields.description: Date of the action (first day of the period when imprecise).

fields.name: jurisdiction
fields.description: US (federal), ISO 3166-2 (US-LA), place (US-LA:new-orleans) or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

fields.name: summary
fields.description: Direct answer to what happened, with {c:ID} claim references.

fields.name: what_happened
fields.description: Narrative of the action, Markdown with {c:ID} claim references.

fields.name: stated_justification
fields.description: The reason the actor gave, quoted verbatim, with claim references.

fields.name: effect_on_reporting
fields.description: What changed for reporting, with claim references.

fields.name: unknowns
fields.description: What the record does not establish, stated in terms of the record.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status value from the table's enumerated list.

fields.name: pub_state
fields.description: draft, published or withdrawn. Withdrawn rows keep identity fields; prose is null.

fields.name: reviewed_on
fields.description: Date of the last full review against sources.

fields.name: next_review_on
fields.description: Date the next full review is due.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: Revision number; every prose change appends a revision.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp the row was created.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: UTC timestamp of the last content change.
